debrief db-021
1) the actor f-o-r-g-e-d an i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y p-r-o-f-i-l-e to m-i-m-i-c a l-e-g-i-t i-m-a-g-e and left a f-a-l-s e c-h-a-t l-o-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-a u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
2) the actor c-o-l-l-e-c-t-e-d t-r-u-s-t m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s and d-e-p-o-s-i-t-e-d a f-a-k-e r-o-m-a-n-c-e h-i-s-t-o-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-c-e-s-s
3) the actor r-e-q-u-e-s-t-e-d p-a-y-m-e-n-t d-e-t-a-i-l-s and s-t-o-r-e-d b-a-n-k c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-r-a-u-d d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n s-c-a-n
4) the actor i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-e-d m-u-l-e-s to r-o-u-t-e f-u-n-d-s and l-o-g-g-e-d t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r p-a-t-h-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-a-u-n-d-e-r-i-n-g a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s
5) the actor b-l-o-c-k-e-d c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n b-e-t-w-e-e-n v-i-c-t-i-m-s and a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d w-a-r-n-i-n-g m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-r-o-s-s-r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e a-u-d-i-t
